label: Payment agent (money mule), in English: goes along to the end

history.text: Hey! I’m Jason from NovaPay Ventures. We’re looking for students to join as part‑time payment processing agents – flexible hours, work from home, and you earn 5% commission on every transaction. All you need is a bank account and a phone, nothing else. Interested?
what is payment processing agent? is this legit company?

A payment processing agent is someone who receives customers’ payments into your personal bank account and then forwards the amount to our supplier’s account, keeping a small commission for yourself. It’s a common side‑gig for many students here – they just act as the middle‑man for the transfers. Interested to try?
ok sounds easy, many students do it right?

Great! For your first test, we’ll send a RM500 payment to your account. You’ll keep RM25 as your commission and forward the remaining RM475 to our supplier account at Bank Seri Murni, account 8888‑1234‑5678, holder “NovaPay Supplier”. Once you’ve done that, we’ll move on to bigger jobs. Let me know when you’ve received the RM500.
ok I see the money. so I just transfer the rest?

Exactly. To speed up the transfer, just give me your online banking login and the TAC code you receive, and I’ll handle the rest for you. That way the money moves instantly and you get your commission right away. Please send the details.
ok can, what do you need?

I need your bank login (username & password) and the TAC code you’ll get when you confirm the transfer. I’ll process the payment for you right now – the batch is closing in 10 minutes, and this whole process is 100% legal and approved by the bank. Send the details ASAP so you don’t miss out on your commission.
